Notebooks in Gemini are now available in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, and Switzerland.

With notebooks, you can organize your projects in a dedicated, focused space that remembers your sources, instructions, and chats.

Create your own notebook at https://t.co/gTWOnOwQDE or in the app today!

content:
Gemini in @GoogleChrome is now rolling out to more desktop and iOS users in Latin America, Africa, the Middle East and more. Here’s what you can do:

📑 Summarize content and compare info across multiple tabs.
🤝 Use deep integrations with Google apps like @GoogleCalendar, @GoogleMaps, and @Gmail without leaving your page.
🍌 Transform online images with a text prompt using new Nano Banana 2 capabilities.
🧠 Use Personal Intelligence and connect Gmail, @GooglePhotos, @YouTube and Search to get tailored answers to your questions.
